paragraphs: Rabbi Acha son of Rav Chiyya: Nedarim 10b.
Rabbi Ami bar Chiyya: Zevachim 105b, and Avodah Zarah 51b.
Rabbi Binyamin bar Chiyya: end of Rosh Hashanah.
Rav Yosef bar Chiyya (Rav Yosef without further designation): Chullin 18b.
Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chiyya Ketubah: Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim, chapter 1, halakhah 8, followed by the supplied י.
Rabbi Levi bar Chiyya: end of Berakhot.
Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Chiyya: Chullin 47. Mar Ukva bar Chiyya: Yevamot 63b. Mar bar Chiyya: Bava Batra 165b. Anan bar Chiyya: Yevamot 116a.
Rav Shmuel bar Chiyya: Bava Metzia 72b. Shimon bar Chiyya: Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin, chapter 5, halakhah 5.
Rabbi Tanchum bar Chiyya: Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan, chapter 3, halakhah 7.

notes.text: The chapter/halakhah locations are Jerusalem Talmud. כתובה is kept as the accompanying epithet Ketubah; the final י after halakhah8 remains literal rather than proof of a specific pagination system. Unsided Shabbat47/Chullin47 are not assigned a new side.

This is a collective patronymic index. The directly consulted Nedarim 10b names Rav Acha son of Rav Chiyya addressing Rav Ashi; it does not establish one father for every person in the list. Ketubah and the supplied final י are retained without a new pagination claim.
